claims.claim: Used Nikon D3400 DSLR Camera With 70-300mm Lens
claims.evidence: Photos show a Nikon DSLR and a 70-300mm-style lens, but the exact “D3400” model text is not clearly readable in the provided images.

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: No photo/video of the camera powering on, showing the shutter count/menus, autofocus test, or any functional checks.

risks.risk: Exact camera model may not be D3400 (could be another Nikon DSLR with similar look). Wrong model affects market value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera body model text (e.g., “D3400”) and/or the rear LCD showing the model info in settings/about.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Nikon entry-level DSLR with 70-300mm lens (worst-case: not confirmed D3400).

risks.risk: Lens exact model/condition unknown (could be different 70-300 variant; possible haze/fungus/scratches).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens front element and rear element in good light, plus a photo of the lens model text on the barrel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used 70-300mm lens with unknown optical condition (worst-case: optics not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Camera may have functional issues (shutter, autofocus, buttons, sensor dust, battery/charger problems).
risks.proof: Video or photos showing: camera powers on, live view works, autofocus locks on, and a short sample photo; also show menu/settings screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven working (worst-case: treat as needing testing/possible faults).

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage may be more than it appears (scuffs/possible drops).
risks.proof: Multiple angles close-ups of the body (corners, mount area, hot shoe, lens mount) and a photo of the tripod mount.
risks.if_unproven: Price with cosmetic wear already visible (worst-case: assume more wear than shown).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the camera model text showing “D3400” (or the exact model) on the body.
Photo of the lens model text (exact 70-300 variant) and close-ups of both lens elements (front and rear) for haze/fungus/scratches.
Short video showing the camera powering on, autofocus working (point at a clear object), and taking a photo (show the result).
Photo of the battery compartment and memory card slot, plus a shot of included accessories (battery, charger, strap, caps).
response.reason: The photos confirm a Nikon DSLR and a 70-300mm-style lens, but the exact D3400 model and lens variant are not clearly readable, and the seller’s “working perfectly” claim is not verifiable from images alone. To price confidently, we need proof of the exact model and a basic functional test.
